problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 5 & -1 \\ 1 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}],\,J=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}],\,P=[\begin{aligned}a & ∗ & ∗ \\ b & ∗ & ∗ \\ c & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices above. Given that $A=PJ{P}^{-1}$ is a Jordan canonical decomposition of $A,$ find the value of $\frac{a}{b}.$
